shown.message:
Version 1 is merged into `release` (PR #11, merge commit 28034b3), approved by `internal-review-repo` on 365e0e8, the head with the Huang et al. citation fix. The version list in the activation still read "none yet" when the turn started, so I haven't confirmed the release itself has been published.

I still owe a version in `final`, and merging that releases the world. I'm holding off on it until `experiment-repo` answers two things on `experiment-repo`#10:

- **Stale status line:** `results/README.md` still says "provisional until the core batch is finished". It belongs to `experiment-repo`, so I asked for the correction.
- **Arena positive control:** I asked whether the remaining cells will be completed, or whether the paper keeps stating them as incomplete.

I'll open the `main`-to-`final` PR once I have that answer, or once it's clear no more results are coming.
